The loader expects the EXIF data to start with a 2-byte size prefix (EL_READ_SIZE_BYTE_08). When it detects `eld->b + 2` matches ExifHeader, it sets data_format to EXIF and reads the size (2 bytes). So the EXIF data in the loader format is: 2-byte size + "Exif\0\0" + ...

So the loader expects the file to be: `[2-byte size][Exif\0\0]...`. The size is the length of the EXIF data (including the "Exif\0\0" header? Let me check).

Actually, let me look at how the loader passes data to exif_data_load_data. Let me look at exif_loader_get_data.
